This is of course humorous because ice and show are usually white. So the sketch is about two white anchors talking about "black ice" and how horrible it is, while two black correspondents get unreasonably offended as they take it more and more personally.

Personally I don't like racial humor just for this reason. People frequently don't understand it. They're mostly "in-jokes" that if you aren't part of the culture, you couldn't possibly understand. A lot of people wind up laughing for the wrong reasons. Instead of laughing at specific joke and going "hey, this joke makes fun of the way people perceive asian people vs. how they really are!" people just laugh at "haha.. stupid asian people".
